channel.title: Midnight blog - en - Last 7 days
channel.description: 记录软件从需求、架构设计、开发、测试到发布、运维与持续改进的工程实践，讨论具体约束、方案取舍和验证方法。AI 是工具链的一部分。 | Language: en | Range: Last 7 days

item.title: Deploying a Hexo + Midnight Blog: Build from Source or Publish Static Files?
item.description: A maintainable Hexo + Midnight blog depends on separating source, the public build, hosting, and DNS. Compare Vercel source builds with a separate static-artifact repository, then verify the release boundary.

item.title: Why can a long loop still block inside requestIdleCallback?
item.description: Use a four-item queue to explain cooperative idle budgets, separating an unexecuted page from an executed timeout-policy fixture.

item.title: How can a selected CTest test bring its setup and cleanup along?
item.description: Verify fixture setup and cleanup added for selected consumers, including failed preparation and independent logs.

item.title: Why do files written to a writable RUN bind mount vanish in the next step?
item.description: Verify RUN bind-write lifetime with separate output paths, a read-only failure, and a stage-source control.

item.title: How can check-ignore explain a rule match for an already-tracked file?
item.description: Diagnose ignore patterns separately from index state, including verbose negated-pattern output.

item.title: Why does Base64 Strict still accept a newline?
item.description: Check valid bits, invalid bits, CRLF and unpadded forms against the precise Strict contract in an unexecuted Go fixture.

item.title: Why does O_CREATE leave the old suffix after a shorter write?
item.description: Distinguish creation, overwriting, truncation and append with independent full-content oracles in an unexecuted Go fixture.

item.title: Why does Read start at ab after ReadAt returned cd?
item.description: Separate offset reads, sequential progress and explicit Seek with interleaved byte and short-read oracles; Go fixture unexecuted.

item.title: Why can inputs remain outside a form after their fieldset gets a form attribute?
item.description: Inspect the owners of an external fieldset and its inputs, then test an unmatched explicit form override inside a form.

item.title: HTTP 414: why can a long query still fail after the body is emptied?
item.description: Compare three local ASCII-target cases, distinguish URI length from content capacity, and identify evidence needed for repeated 414 responses.

item.title: Why does a JSON reviver visit children before their parent?
item.description: Trace child deletion and the parent snapshot, then inspect a new array-index case without confusing deletion with compaction.

item.title: Why can a String.raw result still contain an actual newline?
item.description: Compare literal segments and evaluated substitutions by exact code units, then inspect an ordinary call with fewer substitutions.

item.title: Why can a stored string still fail isWellFormed?
item.description: Inspect lone and paired UTF-16 surrogates by exact units, distinguish replacement from recovery, and test a new URI-encoding consumer.

item.title: Why does an updated image not start a rollout while a Deployment is paused?
item.description: Correlate paused template edits with the resumed rollout identity; the cluster fixture is unrun.

item.title: Why can AP differ from trapezoidal area on the same PR curve?
item.description: Derive AP of 5/6 and trapezoidal area of 19/24 from three ranked examples, then inspect a separate tied-score condition.

item.title: How can you restore a monkeypatch before the test ends?
item.description: Restore scoped patches before teardown and verify normal, exceptional, and nested-owner behavior.

item.title: Why does ^ still use the original string origin in a fullmatch window?
item.description: Check original spans, sliced spans and real-newline controls to distinguish bounded matching from a new string origin.

item.title: Why does redirect_stdout capture another thread too?
item.description: Separate global capture, restoration and explicit streams with a controlled joined worker and an independent stderr check.

item.title: Why can casefold match Straße when lower cannot?
item.description: Separate caseless matching from original-text highlighting using expansion, offset and canonical-composition controls.

item.title: Why is a ZINTER score eight when the inputs were one and two?
item.description: Use independent integer oracles and a reversed-order control to explain weighting before aggregation; Redis commands unexecuted.

item.title: Does RestartPreventExitStatus turn a failed exit into success?
item.description: Separate restart prevention from successful-exit classification with two same-exit fixtures; Linux execution remains unrun.

item.title: Why can validate_only succeed while the resource remains unchanged?
item.description: Compare equal success responses with different stored states and retain permission checks, request mode, and later reads.

item.title: Why does a mute toggle keep the Mute label when aria-pressed changes?
item.description: Compare a stable Mute label with pressed and teaching mute states, and distinguish that design from changing action labels.

item.title: Why can a pointer-events:none ancestor still observe its child’s click?
item.description: Distinguish an auto child hit from its ancestor event path, with capture and bubble logs and two physical click locations.

item.title: How can CTest give the active phase its own timeout after waiting?
item.description: Verify a CTest timeout transition with fast, slow, and unmatched branches, preserving failed preflight assumptions.

item.title: How can Docker ADD verify the expected content after a remote download?
item.description: Pin an approved digest, exercise matching and one-character-wrong builds, and verify exported bytes beyond download success.

item.title: Why can Git report LF while the working file contains CRLF?
item.description: Read index and disk bytes independently to interpret Git EOL content fields and conversion attributes.

item.title: Why does Marshal sort map keys despite varying iteration order?
item.description: Check ordinary map encoding against a fixed text oracle, including integer-to-string key conversion.

item.title: Why does a map keep two Time keys for the same instant?
item.description: Compare Equal, structural equality, and normalized map keys for two location representations of one instant.

item.title: Why can setRangeText produce the same text with different selections?
item.description: Compare three selection modes for one replacement and retain the text plus both endpoints before the next editing action.

item.title: Why can a new defineProperty value resist writes and disappear from key lists?
item.description: Compare new descriptor and literal properties through values, flags, keys, and writes, with creation and update treated under their own conditions.

item.title: Why do separator digits appear after splitting with a capturing regex?
item.description: Compare capturing and noncapturing split results, count captures against the limit, and inspect an unmatched capture.

item.title: Why can old ReplicaSets remain with revisionHistoryLimit zero?
item.description: Check current Deployment completion before interpreting zero history and remaining ReplicaSets; cluster execution is unrun.

item.title: Why can constant targets make the default R² score only zero or one?
item.description: Explain non-finite constant-target R² through SSE and SST, retain the replacement parameter, and compare a finite zero.

item.title: How do you tell pytest to test an installed package by name?
item.description: Run pytest by package name outside its checkout and verify interpreter, installation origin, and collected tests.

item.title: Why did the second hash include the first suffix?
item.description: Check copied prefix branches against complete byte inputs, an alias contamination control, and a later update after digest observation.

item.title: Why does heapreplace evict the old minimum for an even smaller input?
item.description: Compare returned and retained values for two incoming scores, then verify the empty-heap startup condition.

item.title: Why has product consumed its input before the first output?
item.description: Observe a finite source at construction and first-read boundaries, then distinguish zero axes from one empty axis.

item.title: Why does unpack reject a complete frame larger than its two-byte header?
item.description: Compare exact and offset header decoding, a short header, payload boundaries, and incomplete fixed records.

item.title: Why does a reverse LPOS search still return a head-based index?
item.description: Compare occurrence rank, head-based positions, reverse result order, and a limited MAXLEN search.

item.title: Where can a systemd service write state with ProtectSystem=strict?
item.description: Keep necessary state writes in a managed directory and check an EROFS control with the same identity; Linux execution remains unrun.
